name: bound-ghost-control
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; export PATH="$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate:$PATH"; test "$(bun --version)" = 1.4.3; lean --version | grep -F '4.34.0'; export LEAN_PATH="$ROOT/lean-kernel:$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(elan which lean)")")")/lib/lean"; cd lean-kernel; for m in Cert Kernel Cyclic Progress StepLaw Steps Sets History Live NonTerm Ghost GhostMap BoundGhost; do if [ ! -f "$m.olean" ]; then lean -o "$m.olean" "$m.lean" > "$OUT/$m.log" 2>&1; fi; done; cd "$ROOT"; lean research/bapa/BoundGhostControl.lean > "$OUT/control.log" 2>&1
